title: schefflera metcalfiana var. langbianensis
intro: Schefflera metcalfiana var. langbianensis, commonly known as the Langbian Schefflera, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate fever, and treat respiratory issues due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Schefflera metcalfiana var. langbianensis include lignans, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential interactions with other treatments.
